# Imperial Concrete Coatings

> Family-owned contractor in Olathe, Kansas that installs epoxy and concrete coatings on residential floors across the Kansas City metro, in Kansas and Missouri.

This is a one page website. Everything a visitor needs is on the home page.

## Key facts

- Services: Epoxy Coatings, Quartz Coatings, Marble Finishes, Metallic Epoxy, Concrete Coatings.
- Spaces: garages, basements, patios and pool decks. Residential work.
- Experience: over 20 years in the flooring trade.
- Estimates: sent within 24 hours of a request.
- Licensed and insured. Family-owned.
- Service area: Olathe, Overland Park, Lenexa, Shawnee, Leawood, Gardner, Kansas City KS, Kansas City MO, Lee's Summit, Independence, Blue Springs and Liberty.
- Location: Olathe, Kansas.
- Phone and text: (913) 995-2657.
- Email: imperialccoatings@gmail.com.
